questions.knowledge_point: Applying Row Operations to a Complex Matrix
questions.problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ -\text{i} & 5+\text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operation:

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+\frac{\text{i}}{1-\text{i}}{R}_{1}
$$
questions.worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ -\text{i} & 5+\text{i}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+\frac{\text{i}}{1-\text{i}}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ -\text{i}+\frac{\text{i}(1-\text{i})}{1-\text{i}} & 5+\text{i}-\frac{2\text{i}}{1-\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ -\text{i}+\text{i} & \frac{(5+\text{i})\cdot (1-\text{i})-2\text{i}}{1-\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ 0 & 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result  is 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ 0 & 6\end{aligned}].
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Computing Components of the Real and Imaginary Parts of a Complex Matrix
questions.problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}e & f \\ g & h\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2-3\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ 1+\text{i} & 5\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $cd+gh?$
questions.worked_solution:
For the given matrix $A,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}2-3\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ 1+\text{i} & 5\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2-3\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ 1+\text{i} & 0+5\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(A)}+\text{i}{{[\begin{aligned}-3 & -1 \\ 1 & 5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(A)}.\end{aligned}
$$

So we have $c=1,d=0,g=1$ and $h=5.$ Therefore,

$$
cd+gh=1\cdot 0+1\cdot 5=5.
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Computing Components of the Real and Imaginary Parts of a Complex Matrix
questions.problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}e & f \\ g & h\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}8 & 1-6\text{i} \\ 3+\text{i} & 4+2\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $bc+eg?$
questions.worked_solution:
For the given matrix $A,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}8 & 1-6\text{i} \\ 3+\text{i} & 4+2\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}8+0\text{i} & 1-6\text{i} \\ 3+\text{i} & 4+2\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}8 & 1 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(A)}+\text{i}{{[\begin{aligned}0 & -6 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(A)}.\end{aligned}
$$

So we have $b=1,c=3,e=0$ and $g=1.$ Therefore,

$$
bc+eg=1\cdot 3+0\cdot 1=3.
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Applying Row Operations to a Complex Matrix
questions.problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1+2\text{i} & -2-4\text{i} \\ 3-2\text{i} & \text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following  elementary row operations:

$$
{R}_{1}=\frac{1}{1+2\text{i}}{R}_{1},\,{R}_{2}={R}_{2}+(2\text{i}-3){R}_{1}
$$
questions.worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1+2\text{i} & -2-4\text{i} \\ 3-2\text{i} & \text{i}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{1+2\text{i}}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 3-2\text{i} & \text{i}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(2\text{i}-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 0 & 6-3\text{i}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result is

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 0 & 6-3\text{i}\end{aligned}].
$$
